SMAM.target_group: Individual farmers, Women farmers, SC/ST, Small & Marginal farmers
SMAM.rates: 50% for SC/ST/Small/Marginal/Women/NE States (capped as per Annexure-I); 40% for General/OBC

documents.item: Aadhaar Card (UID)
Passport-size photograph
Record of Rights (RoR) / Land Record (7/12, Khasra, Khatauni)
First page of Bank Passbook / Cancelled Cheque
documents.purpose: Bank account IFSC and account number for DBT subsidy credit

documents.item: Government ID Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Driving License / PAN)
Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC)
documents.purpose: Mandatory only for claiming 50% priority subsidy

process_steps: 1. Register on agrimachinery.nic.in using Aadhaar & mobile number.
2. Select State, District, Sub-District, Block, and Village from dropdowns.
3. Provide land details with scanned RoR document.
4. Choose machine and empanelled dealer from the approved list.
5. Online application submitted to State Level Executive Committee (SLEC).
6. Verification, sanction order issued, and subsidy released directly via DBT.

CRM.target_group: Farmers, CHCs, FPOs, and Panchayats in Punjab, Haryana, UP, and Delhi
CRM.rates: 50% for individual farmers; 80% for Custom Hiring Centres (project cost ₹5L-₹15L)

documents.item: Aadhaar Card & Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID)
documents.purpose: Identification on state portal (e.g. Haryana PPP)

documents.item: Meri Fasal Mera Byora (MFMB) Registration
Land Record (Jamabandi / Farad)
documents.purpose: Proof of land cultivated with paddy/wheat

documents.item: Bank Account Details (Aadhaar-seeded)
Under-taking not to burn crop residue

process_steps: 1. Register on State CRM Portal (Haryana MechCRM / Punjab Agrimachinery / UP Agriculture).
2. Enter Family ID / Farmer ID to fetch verified land details.
3. Select approved CRM machinery (Super Seeder, Baler, Happy Seeder, Mulcher).
4. State lottery/selection process triggers sanction token.
5. Purchase machine from empanelled dealer and upload invoice & GPS photo.
6. Physical verification by Agriculture Development Officer followed by DBT credit.

CHC.target_group: Rural youth entrepreneurs, Cooperatives, Registered Farmer Societies, FPOs, Panchayats
CHC.rates: 40% capital subsidy on project cost up to ₹250 Lakhs (80% up to ₹15L under CRM; 50% up to ₹9L for Agriculture Graduates for Drone CHC)

documents.item: Registration Certificate of Society / FPO / Firm / Partnership
Detailed Project Report (DPR)
documents.purpose: Machinery list, business viability, and financial plan

documents.item: Bank Loan Sanction Letter / Term Loan Agreement
Land ownership / Lease deed for Machinery Shed (minimum 5-10 years)
Agriculture Degree Certificate (for Agri-Graduate 50% Drone CHC)

process_steps: 1. Formulate Detailed Project Report (DPR) with machine list matching regional cropping patterns.
2. Secure term loan from commercial / cooperative bank (Bank-linked subsidy model).
3. Apply online at agrimachinery.nic.in under CHC component.
4. State Level Executive Committee (SLEC) review and project sanction.
5. Subsidy kept in Subsidy Reserve Fund (SRF) account and adjusted against loan principal.

FMB.full_name: Village Level Farm Machinery Bank (FMB) (SMAM Component 4.3)
FMB.target_group: Cooperative Societies, Registered Farmer Societies, SHGs, FPOs, Panchayats
FMB.rates: 80% financial assistance up to ₹30 Lakhs (max ₹24L subsidy); 90% up to ₹27L for FRA Patta holders; 95% up to ₹28.5L in NER

documents.item: Society / SHG / FPO Registration Certificate
Resolution of General Body / Executive Committee
documents.purpose: Formal resolution to set up Farm Machinery Bank

documents.item: List of Member Farmers with Aadhaar Numbers & Land Holdings
Bank Account Details of the Society / Group
FRA Patta certificate (if claiming 90% tribal assistance)

process_steps: 1. Village selection based on low mechanization index in rainfed/aspirational district.
2. Society/SHG submits resolution and machine equipment requisition.
3. Approval by District Nodal Committee and SLEC.
4. Procurement from empanelled manufacturers.
5. Commissioning of machinery bank and online listing on FARMS mobile app.

NAMO_DRONE_DIDI.full_name: Central Sector Scheme Namo Drone Didi
NAMO_DRONE_DIDI.target_group: Women Self Help Groups (SHGs) under DAY-NRLM / State Rural Livelihood Missions
NAMO_DRONE_DIDI.rates: 80% Central Financial Assistance up to ₹8.00 Lakhs for drone, accessories, and training. Balance 20% funded via AIF loan with 3% interest subvention.

documents.item: DAY-NRLM SHG Registration Certificate
documents.purpose: Proof of active Women SHG status under SRLM

documents.item: Resolution nominating 2 members (1 Drone Pilot, 1 Drone Assistant)
documents.purpose: DGCA approved Remote Pilot Training certification

documents.item: Educational Certificate (Minimum 10th pass for pilot nominee)
SHG Bank Passbook / AIF Loan Account Details

process_steps: 1. Selection of SHG by State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM) and Lead Fertilizer Companies (LFC).
2. Nominated member completes 15-day DGCA-certified drone pilot training course.
3. Drone package (DGCA type certified drone, batteries, charging hub, spray nozzles) supplied by empanelled OEM.
4. 80% subsidy released directly; remaining 20% sanctioned under Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF).
5. SHG offers rental spraying services to regional farmers at ₹300-₹500/acre.
